_what: What TradingView actually does for `ta.cum` and for the four context namespaces `Uncharted Volume` needs (`timeframe.*`, `syminfo.*`, `barstate.*`, `str.*`). One probe, SPY 1D, read off the chart model. ⚠️ MEASUREMENT ONLY — this file records what the vendor does and takes no position on whether `ta.cum` should ship. That question is open: `closedTable.json::_functions_cumulative` had already refused a host/screener split on containment grounds before this capture was taken, and the ruling is back with the owner.

provenance.how: window._exposed_chartWidgetCollection -> activeChartWidget -> model().model().dataSources(); located by metaInfo().shortDescription; per-bar rows via data().each(). Identity proven before any value was accepted.
provenance.bars: The study evaluated 8,459 bars (bar_index 0..8458); the data window exposes the last 400. Values quoted from either are labelled.

_coverage.TA_CUM_SEED: OBSERVED — a series held `na` until bar 8300 reads `na` on 8296-8299 and 1 on 8300.
_coverage.TA_CUM_HISTORY_DEPTH: OBSERVED — ta.cum(1) == bar_index + 1 on every bar, so the seed is bar 0 of the whole loaded series.
_coverage.STR_TOSTRING_FORMATS: OBSERVED for '0.00', '#.##' and '#', across ~400 varied values including an exact integer and negatives.
_coverage.TIMEFRAME_PREDICATES: OBSERVED on a 1D chart only. isweekly/ismonthly are observed FALSE there; their TRUE case is NOT observed.
_coverage.SYMINFO: OBSERVED as lengths and as a '/' containment test — the exact strings are inferred from the lengths, see the note.
_coverage.BARSTATE_FORMING_BAR: ⛔ NOT OBSERVED. The capture was taken with the market closed, so every bar is confirmed history. `isconfirmed`, `ishistory` and `isnew` are 1 on all 8,459 bars and the FORMING-bar value remains unmeasured. This is the gap that keeps `barstate.*` refused for a pane until realtime is tested.

ta_cum.reading: `ta.cum` seeds at bar 0 of the WHOLE loaded series, not at the left edge of the visible window. On a daily SPY chart that is ~33 years.

na_before_first_finite_input.reading: `na` until the first finite input, then the running total begins at that bar.

na_mid_series.reading: ⭐⭐ THE OUTPUT IS `na` ON THE `na` BAR, AND THE TOTAL IS HELD. 7330 -> na -> 7331: it neither advances nor resets. The final value equals the count of finite inputs exactly, so a skipped bar contributes nothing rather than resetting the accumulator.
na_mid_series.⛔_differs_from_the_spec_as_written: The implementation spec said `na inputs contribute 0 once the series has started`. The TOTAL behaves that way — it is unchanged — but the OUTPUT on that bar is `na`, not the held total. Implementing the spec's literal wording would draw a value on a bar TradingView leaves blank. This is the same HOLD rule already pinned for `ta.ema`/`ta.rma`/`ta.rsi`/`ta.macd` on 2026-09-08, now shown to cover the accumulator family too.

str_tostring.probe: tv = (bar_index % 997) / 7.0, plotted as str.tonumber(str.tostring(tv, fmt)) and str.length(str.tostring(tv, fmt))
str_tostring.reading: Standard optional/required digit semantics. `0` is a REQUIRED digit position and pads: 12 -> "12.00". `#` is OPTIONAL and drops trailing zeros AND the decimal point with them: 12 -> "12". Both round half-away-from-zero at the last kept place. The sign is a leading character, so a negative is one longer.
str_tostring.why_it_matters: `Uncharted Volume` formats nine table cells with these three formats. Step 7's table-text comparison cannot pass without them being exact.

timeframe.⚠️_not_observed: The TRUE case for isweekly/ismonthly. They are implemented from the chart's own declared timeframe, which this engine already holds — but only the daily row is vendor-witnessed.

syminfo.reading: On SPY the `ticker` is 3 characters ("SPY") and the `tickerid` is 8, consistent with "AMEX:SPY" — an EXCHANGE:SYMBOL form. Neither contains "/".
syminfo.⚠️_inference_stated: The lengths are measured; the exact strings are INFERRED from them, because a string cannot be plotted. `Uncharted Volume` only ever asks whether they contain "/", which IS measured, so the inference is not load-bearing for that script.

barstate.reading: `islast` is true on exactly one bar, the newest. `isconfirmed`/`ishistory` are true on every bar of a closed-market capture.
barstate.⛔_the_gap: This says nothing about a FORMING bar, which is the only case where these values are interesting and the only case a chart pane adds over a screener. Until a realtime capture exists, `barstate.*` stays refused in host mode.

rules_established.ta.cum: Running total seeded at bar 0 of the delivered series. `na` before the first finite input; `na` ON an `na` bar; the total HELD across it (contributes nothing, does not reset); resumes on the next finite bar.
rules_established.str.tostring(x, '#.##'): Up to two decimals, trailing zeros and a bare decimal point dropped.
rules_established.timeframe.isdaily/isweekly/ismonthly: Predicates on the chart's own timeframe; only the 1D row is witnessed.
rules_established.syminfo.ticker / tickerid: Bare symbol and EXCHANGE:SYMBOL respectively; neither contains '/' for an ordinary equity.
rules_established.barstate.islast: True on exactly the newest bar.
rules_established.barstate.isconfirmed / ishistory: True on every closed bar; the forming-bar value is UNMEASURED.
